name: Polvo / Tubarao Martelo cluster
description: PetroRio holds 80% of Tubarao Martelo; cluster economic life to 2037 on 1P reserves per DeGolyer & MacNaughton; emissions fell from 18.6 to 13.7 kg CO2 per barrel.

milestones.event: PetroRio completed Polvo-Tubarao Martelo tieback and cut cluster OPEX
Golar reported Q3 2023 FLNG vessel operating expenses
NSTA reported UKCS unit operating costs

capex.metric: Polvo/Tubarao Martelo cluster OPEX reduction from eliminating chartered FPSO
capex.basis: PetroRio statement quoted by Offshore Engineer: reduction comprises Polvo FPSO lease, maintenance and diesel expenses.

capex.metric: Cluster total operating cost before tieback
capex.basis: PetroRio statement as quoted; field-cluster level, includes more than FPSO costs.

capex.metric: Cluster total operating cost after tieback
capex.basis: PetroRio statement as quoted; approximately USD 70 million per year.
PetroRio statement: tieback completed in 11 months; one-off project CAPEX, not a unit cost.

capex.metric: FLNG segment vessel operating expenses, Q3 2023
capex.basis: Golar Q3 2023 statement of operations; FLNG segment (Hilli operating plus Gimi pre-operational); not a per-unit annual OPEX.
NSTA UKCS Unit Operating Costs 2020, 2020 prices; all UKCS facilities, used only as a peer benchmark, not mobile-only.
NSTA report executive summary; down nearly GBP 0.8bn (11%) year on year; all UKCS, not mobile-only.
